189 else
190
191 # the codeinstance cache to use -- should only be used for the constructor
192 # Note that the only way the interpreter modifies codegen is either not inlining a fwd mode
193 # rule or not inlining a rev mode rule. Otherwise, all caches can be re-used.
194 const GLOBAL_FWD_CACHE = GPUCompiler.CodeCache()
195 const GLOBAL_REV_CACHE = GPUCompiler.CodeCache()
196 function enzyme_ci_cache(job::CompilerJob{<:Any,<:AbstractEnzymeCompilerParams})
197 return if job.config.params.mode == API.DEM_ForwardMode
198 GLOBAL_FWD_CACHE
199 else
200 GLOBAL_REV_CACHE
201 end
202 end
